- Added a narrow type guard so that only rows with a numeric `id` and string `name` are treated as `User` objects, eliminating the `Value` → `User` assignment issue.
```12:23:app/page.tsx
  const { rows } = await turso.execute("SELECT * FROM users");
  console.log(rows);

  const isUserRow = (row: (typeof rows)[number]): row is User => {
    return typeof row.id === "number" && typeof row.name === "string";
  };

  const users: User[] = rows.filter(isUserRow);
```
- Updated the JSX to display the derived `users` list rather than the untyped `rows`.
